subject: Renewal request — log retention increase, security re-attestation, and capacity uplift for Edgeworth
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@edgeworth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgeworth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal inquiry — SOC 2 recert + retention increase

Hi Vivek,

We're preparing for our contract renewal with Redwood (renewal window late May) and need to confirm a couple of security items before we proceed:

1) SOC 2 recertification timeline — our audit team needs the attestation date and whether Redwood will provide a scoped recert for our EU and US regions.
2) Log retention — we're evaluating moving from 90 days to 540 days for audit logs (ingest is ~1.2 TB/month today). We need to understand technical approach, egress/transfer, and estimated monthly cost.
3) Evidence handoff — what file formats and transfer mechanisms do you support for bulk evidence? (S3/FTPS preferred)

Can we get a short plan and a point of contact from your side to coordinate evidence and a contract amendment for retention + seat uplift? Also flagging procurement on Cc.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Security Operations — Edgeworth Financial
[m] +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: evidence-manifest-template.csv (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@edgeworth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — SOC 2 recert + retention increase

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. I'll own the coordination from Redwood. High level plan below; attaching an evidence manifest template and a draft contract amendment for retention/seat uplift.

Plan (summary)
- SOC 2: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering infra + ops) was issued 2026-10-12. We are on a 12-month recert cadence; we expect the next attestation window to close by 2027-09 (report available ~2027-11). For renewal purposes we can provide our last report, plus a scoped attestation letter focused on data residency and log handling for your account.

- Retention increase (90 -> 540 days): Technical approach is a two-tier archive. Active hot-tier (first 30 days) on normal log store; cold-tier snapshots to encrypted S3 (customer-dedicated prefix) for days 31-540 with monthly bulk snapshots and a manifest CSV. We support S3 cross-account replication or signed S3 PUT with temporary credentials.

- Evidence handoff: We can deliver compressed evidence bundles (CSV/JSON logs, PDF summaries) via S3 or secure HTTPS transfer. For the SOC material, we will provide a redacted controls mapping and a short runbook describing what we can and cannot share.

Commercials / upsell options
- Capacity uplift: we can increase ingest quota from current 1.2 TB/month to a guaranteed 2.0 TB/month pool.
- Pricing: for 540-day retention and the guaranteed capacity uplift, we can offer a 12% credit against incremental retention storage, and a 10% discount on the first 6 months of the additional throughput commitment (12-month addendum).

Next steps
1) Kimberly will scope the evidence list for your audit team (I cc'ed her).
2) Ben will produce a throughput and cost estimate for 540d retention.
3) I'll loop legal and send a draft amendment for signature once we align.

Can we do a quick call next Wed 2027-04-07 10:30 AM PT to walk through the plan? If that works I will share a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Vivek
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-manifest.csv (stub), draft-amendment-retention-uplift.pdf (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@edgeworth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — SOC 2 recert + retention increase

Thanks for taking the time this morning, Marta. Follow-up with the evidence checklist we discussed on the call attached here and a short note on transfer options.

Quick checklist (high priority for recert)
- Last 6 months of auth logs (CSV) — sample and full export options
- Node access lists and change history (PDF/CSV)
- Config drift snapshots (JSON) — redacted for customer-specific keys
- Incident runbook and last 2 remediation tickets (PDF)
- Retention config and export manifest (CSV)

Transfer options:
- Preferred: Cross-account S3 with a customer-provided bucket and temporary put credentials (fast, scalable).
- Alternate: Secure HTTPS upload (one-time presigned URLs) for zipped bundles.

Ben, can you confirm estimated monthly incremental cost for 540-day retention (1.2 TB baseline -> 540d cold snapshots) and a 2.0 TB committed throughput? Marta, I'll include the estimate in a short summary email by EOD Friday.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior Account Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-checklist-edgeworth-2027-04-07.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@edgeworth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — SOC 2 recert + retention increase

Hi all — cost and capacity numbers below. This includes storage, snapshot transfer, and modest retrieval/restore estimates:

Assumptions
- Current ingest: 1.2 TB/month
- Proposed committed pool: 2.0 TB/month (includes headroom for bursts)
- Cold snapshot frequency: monthly full snapshot compressed ~0.85x raw

Estimate (monthly incremental)
- Incremental storage (540d cold): ~$6,800/month
- Transfer & snapshot orchestration: ~$420/month
- Committed throughput premium (for 2.0 TB pool): ~$1,350/month (with 10% discount on first 6 months)

If Edgeworth signs for a 12-month addendum we can lock the pricing above and apply the 12% credit against incremental storage for months 1-12. I've attached a short breakdown.

Marta — if you prefer a blended all-in per-GB rate I can provide that for procurement.

-Ben
Principal Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Attachment: cost-breakdown-540d-2TB.xlsx (stub)

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@edgeworth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgeworth.com, Edgeworth Security <security@edgeworth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — SOC 2 recert + retention increase

Thanks team — the numbers and plan look reasonable. A few quick items before procurement proceeds: 

1) Can Redwood provide the scoped attestation letter for our renewal (data residency + log handling)? We need that by 2027-05-15 to include with our renewal packet.
2) Please send a DocuSign link for the 12-month retention + 2.0TB throughput addendum with the pricing Ben provided (including the 12% storage credit and 10% onboarding discount).
3) Evidence transfer: we'll provision an S3 bucket and share the cross-account role details. Please confirm final manifest format (CSV columns) and whether you'll encrypt at-rest with our KMS key.

If you can get the amendment and the attestation note to us this week, procurement will start the internal approval path.

-Marta

--
